title: Babah!
description: Babah! is a datapack that makes it possible to cross minecraft's explosion radius limits by taking advantage of quantity of spawned high explosion radius fireballs
body: Do you remember those old 1.12.2 mods that added immense amounts of tnt? #### Have you ever wanted to nuke that one annoying desert village or an ugly mountain? ### Babah! is a datapack for you. By spawning big quantities of fireballs, it takes advantage of quantity and the chaos of minecraft's explosion engine to create truly massive and beautiful explosions.
